title: Anything in Sulfur Cubes
description: Make every block absorbable by the Sulfur Cube with its own properties!
body:
# Anything in Sulfur Cubes

> [See the list of added blocks](https://github.com/lugosieben/anything-in-sulfur-cubes/blob/main/docs/blocks-added.md)

Allows you to put nearly **any** block in Sulfur Cubes, with each having fitting properties, instead of the very limited selection in vanilla!
You can even store your shulkers in Sulfur Cubes and your items will not be lost!

### What blocks are added:

Blocks, which mostly fill the sides of the cube (slabs ❌, composter ✅)
This includes about 150 blocks. The full list of blocks and a more accurate, always updated number is available [here](https://github.com/lugosieben/anything-in-sulfur-cubes/blob/main/docs/blocks-added.md).

## Feature Requests

If you want a block to be changed (or added, if I haven't already), you can [open an issue](https://github.com/lugosieben/anything-in-sulfur-cubes/issues) and i will look at it as soon as possible!

## Transparency Fix

Putting transparent blocks in Sulfur Cubes is possible, but will result in a weird appearance.
To fix this, you can optionally download the [Sulfur Cube Transparency Fix](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/sulfur-cube-transparency-fix) Resource Pack.

## Special Behavior

Next to nearly any block having its own properties in a Sulfur Cube, this pack also introduces extra custom behavior for some blocks!

### Cactus

Touching a Cactus Sulfur Cube will damage you like a normal cactus.

### Creaking Heart

Creaking Heart Sulfur Cubes will play eerie sounds without actually spawning a creaking.

### Potent Sulfur

Sulfur Cubes with Potent Sulfur will give the nausea effect while in contact.
